paragraphs: In Temurah 21a he says: “They asked in the West…” – Abaye said to him, etc.[^1]

notes.text: Two saved Davidson Temurah21a scalars give Rava bar Rav Azza’s They asked in the West report and Abaye’s following address to him. Source בעו differs from witness בען; the English preserves the question report and etc. Full Rav applies to Azza, while Rava and Abaye gain no added titles. Initial ב is In.
